title: Offer userhost-in-names, which NAMES can carry today
description:
~/PROJECT/IETF/specs/ircv3-userhost-in-names.md: with the capability, 353 RPL_NAMREPLY carries each member's full `nick!user@host` instead of the nick alone. The front end holds every member's Identity at the point it builds a 353 (`Session::names_reply`, from `RoomShown::members`), so the mask is in hand and nothing has to be looked up.

It carries the same local@domain identity into NAMES that bead mimid-1wgh.140.6 put into JOIN with extended-join and into every user line with account-tag, so a client that fills its member list from NAMES learns which MIMI user each nick is without a WHOIS per nick.

What it costs: a 353 line holds far fewer names, so a channel of any size takes more lines (`line::pack_words` already splits them to the room the client leaves). Outside bead mimid-1wgh.140.6's candidate list, which is why it was not slipped into that commit.
